text: Today is a day to face whatever feels stuck in your life, with Lord Ganapati as the one who clears the way.
It is about starting, not about waiting.
You are invited to chant 'Om Gam Ganapataye Namaha', offer fresh durva grass and a little jaggery, and perform the evening pooja after moonrise if it suits your home.
Take a moment to name one thing you have been putting off, and take the first small step on it today.
